---
title: "Trap: a document title far too long to repeat in the running header, which has one line of 8.5pt type and the width of the measure, less the logo"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

The running header repeats the title, and fancyhdr lets it run under the logo
or wrap onto a second line without a word in the log. The build must stop and
name short_title, which gives the header a form that fits.
